contexts.text: Laws in the Jewish Church concerning the prerogative of the man, and the obedience of the wife.
Why should (the Jews) affect a prerogative in Heaven?
The prerogative or more perfect faculty of the Angels...
Not from a dignity prerogative above others; but from mutual love.
